title: Waacking Dance Tutorial | Tee J Choreography | theverbstudio.com

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, step-by-step instructions with a focus on precision and timing. She frequently demonstrates the moves from different angles to ensure the students understand the technique.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces herself and the dance style.
The teacher breaks down the first sequence of moves.
The teacher counts the steps for the students to follow.
The teacher explains the 'psyche' move and the hand shift.
The teacher explains the arm movement around the head.
The teacher explains the lower body movement.

metaphors: hit on counts till 8 in different directions
common_mistakes: not doing the arm movement around the head separately

steps_taught.name: lower body movement
steps_taught.description: Rotating hips from left to right.

what_works: breaking down complex moves into smaller parts
what_hinders: the pace might be too fast for absolute beginners

quotes.text: on four we look up with our hands on our shoulder
on psyche we have to just shift our hands
we just have to hit on counts till eight in different directions
this step goes around your head
while doing it you have to do it separately
rotate from left to right with your hips
